story_chapters.title: PROLOGUE
story_chapters.text:
In the heart of a vast, unspoiled land lie several valleys filled with forests, rivers, mountains, and open plains.

**Maiya** and **Luna**, twin sisters, know this land better than anyone. Raised close to nature, they have become formidable fighters through years of rigorous training and mastery of the martial arts.

They live simple lives, watch over the villagers, and step in whenever someone is in danger.

But lately, something has changed.

Machines are appearing along the edges of the valleys.

The rivers are growing murky.

The animals are disappearing.

And thick clouds of smoke are rising on the horizon.

Behind it all is a ruthless industrialist: **Lord Smoggar**.

His ambition is to transform this untouched land, piece by piece, into a vast industrial empire.

To accelerate his plans, he has **Sunboy** kidnapped — the young prince who opposes his expansion.

As soon as Maiya hears the news, she decides to set out and rescue him.

Luna stays behind to protect the valley and its people.

And so Maiya's adventure begins.

story_chapters.title: MISSION 1 — EMERALD FOREST
story_chapters.text:
Maiya enters **Emerald Forest**, a vast woodland that remains largely untouched.

But Smoggar's machines have already established a foothold.

Soldiers patrol between the trees, and industrial facilities loom among the greenery.

Maiya ventures deep into the forest, driving back enemy forces and helping villagers along the way.

She soon discovers that the pollution originates from several facilities scattered throughout the valley.

Deep in the woods, she reaches an area controlled by one of Smoggar's guardians.

After defeating the guardian, Maiya destroys the facility and liberates the region.

Little by little, the forest begins to recover its natural beauty.

But her journey has only just begun.

story_chapters.title: MISSION 2 — SACRED FALLS
story_chapters.text:
Maiya's next destination is **Sacred Falls**.

Towering waterfalls and steep mountain trails dominate the region.

High above the valley, Smoggar has installed machinery to divert the water and bring it under his control.

Maiya must scale the cliffs and cross the waterfalls to reach the enemy installations.

The higher she climbs, the more dangerous the terrain becomes.

At the summit, she faces the forces guarding the region.

Once the enemy is defeated, Maiya destroys the installations.

At last, the water returns to its natural course.

With Sacred Falls liberated, Maiya continues toward the next valley.

story_chapters.title: MISSION 3 — CORAL COAST
story_chapters.text:
Maiya's journey leads her to **Coral Coast**.

This time, the threat comes from the sea.

Industrial complexes have appeared along the shoreline, dumping waste that is beginning to contaminate the water.

Maiya makes her way along coastal trails, across docks, and through areas overrun by machines.

She soon realizes that Smoggar's operations extend much farther than she originally imagined.

The valleys are not being attacked at random.

They are all part of a single, carefully coordinated plan.

Maiya presses forward and confronts those responsible for polluting the coast.

Another region is liberated.

story_chapters.title: MISSION 4 — AUTUMN GROVE
story_chapters.text:
Maiya arrives at **Autumn Grove**.

This valley was once famous for its trees and their brilliant fall colors.

But Smoggar's industrial operations have begun to devastate the landscape.

Several mountain passes have been destroyed, and many trails have become dangerous.

Maiya fights her way through the damaged terrain, battling the soldiers protecting the installations.

Eventually, she reaches the heart of the contaminated area.

After a fierce battle, the machines finally grind to a halt.

The villagers can once again travel freely throughout their valley.

But Maiya can feel it: the attacks are growing more aggressive.

Smoggar is getting closer to achieving his goal.

story_chapters.title: MISSION 5 — CRYSTAL GROTTO
story_chapters.text:
Maiya's journey continues into **Crystal Grotto**.

Beneath the mountains lies a vast network of caverns and underground tunnels.

Smoggar uses these passages to transport materials and supply his industrial network.

Maiya must navigate the caves, overcome dangerous obstacles, and fight the forces guarding the underground facilities.

There, she uncovers another part of Smoggar's plan:

The resources extracted from the natural world are being used to power his machines.

Maiya destroys the main facility.

But before leaving, she learns that Smoggar's operations extend much farther south.

story_chapters.title: MISSION 6 — WORLD TREE / SUNKEN REEF / SILVER CAVE
story_chapters.text:
Maiya's adventure takes her into increasingly distant lands.

She climbs the towering heights of the **World Tree**, explores the underwater depths of **Sunken Reef**, and ventures into the mysterious **Silver Cave**.

Each region presents a unique environment and conceals another part of Smoggar's industrial network.

Maiya faces new enemies and gradually discovers the true scale of his organization.

The facilities are growing larger.

The machines are becoming more powerful.

And the defenses are increasingly sophisticated.

Yet with every victory, Maiya liberates another part of the land.

At last, she begins closing in on the center of Smoggar's operation.

And this time, the landscape changes completely.

story_chapters.title: MISSION 7 — RIO NEGRO WORKS
story_chapters.text:
Maiya reaches **Rio Negro Works**.

For the first time, she enters the very heart of Smoggar's industrial territory.

Here, the trees are gone.

Natural trails have been replaced by steel structures, platforms, and elevated walkways.

The factories operate around the clock.

Thick smoke fills the sky.

**Barrels of toxic waste** are transported throughout the complex.

Maiya realizes that Rio Negro Works is one of the main sources of pollution affecting the entire region.

She fights her way through the industrial complex and begins shutting down the systems responsible for the contamination.

But Smoggar has prepared a powerful response.

A formidable mechanical guardian appears.

story_chapters.title: IRON VULTURE
story_chapters.text:
**Iron Vulture** is the mechanical guardian of Rio Negro Works.

To continue her mission, Maiya must defeat this powerful machine.

After an exhausting battle, she finally brings it down.

One by one, the complex's systems begin shutting down.

But before the facility collapses, the enemy reveals the truth:

**Lord Smoggar is waiting for her at the heart of his empire.**

Maiya now knows what she must do.

She must confront him herself.

story_chapters.title: FINAL CHAPTER — THE CITADEL
story_chapters.text:
Maiya finally reaches **the Citadel**.

It is the center of Smoggar's power.

All around her, industrial facilities stretch as far as the eye can see.

And yet, something has changed.

The regions Maiya has traveled through are already beginning to recover.

The destroyed facilities have fallen silent.

Villagers are reclaiming their land.

And the valleys are slowly returning to their former beauty.

Maiya enters the Citadel.

She breaks through Smoggar's final defenses and reaches the heart of the fortress.

There, she finds **Sunboy**.

The young prince is still being held prisoner.

Maiya sets him free.

At that very moment, Lord Smoggar appears.

story_chapters.title: FINAL BATTLE — LORD SMOGGAR
story_chapters.text:
Smoggar refuses to surrender his empire.

To him, forests, rivers, and untouched wilderness are nothing more than resources waiting to be exploited.

He activates his ultimate defense system.

Maiya prepares for her final battle.

Deep inside the Citadel, she confronts Smoggar.

The fight is long and brutal.

But Maiya draws upon everything she has learned throughout her journey.

In the end, she destroys the central system powering Smoggar's industrial empire.

The machines shut down.

The factories fall silent.

And the thick smoke slowly begins to clear from the sky.

**Lord Smoggar has been defeated.**

story_chapters.title: EPILOGUE
story_chapters.text:
Sunboy is free.

Maiya leaves the Citadel with him by her side.

In the distance, the first regions she liberated are already coming back to life.

The rivers run clear again.

Animals return to the forests.

Villagers return to their homes.

At last, Luna is reunited with her sister.

Standing side by side, the twins look out across the valley.

The battle is over.

But their greatest victory is more than simply defeating Smoggar.

They have protected their homeland and given its people the opportunity to rebuild their future.

Maiya takes one final look toward the horizon.

Little by little, nature is reclaiming what rightfully belongs to it.

**The valley is free.**

**Sunboy is safe.**

**Lord Smoggar is defeated.**

And Maiya, together with Luna, stands ready to defend their homeland whenever a new threat arises.

story_chapters.title: PROLOGUE
story_chapters.text:
Au cœur d’une terre vaste et préservée s’étendent des vallées de forêts, rivières et montagnes.

Maiya et Luna, sœurs jumelles, connaissent cette terre mieux que quiconque. Élevées au contact de la nature, elles maîtrisent les arts martiaux les plus redoutables.

Mais des machines polluantes surgissent sous le commandement du cruel Lord Smoggar. Pour accélérer son empire industriel, il fait enlever le jeune prince Sunboy. Maiya part aussitôt à sa rescousse tandis que Luna protège la vallée !

story_chapters.title: MISSION 1 — FORÊT D’ÉMERAUDE
story_chapters.text: Maiya pénètre dans la Forêt d’Émeraude, où patrouillent les soldats et les machines de Smoggar. Elle repousse les assaillants, libère les villageois, anéantit le gardien et détruit l’usine toxique.

story_chapters.title: MISSION 2 — CASCADES SACRÉES
story_chapters.text: Maiya gravit les Cascades Sacrées pour stopper les machines qui détournent l’eau pure. Au sommet, elle terrasse la garnison ennemie et rend aux cascades leur cours naturel.

story_chapters.title: MISSION 3 — CÔTE DE CORAIL
story_chapters.text: Sur la Côte de Corail, des complexes industriels déversent du poison dans la mer. Maiya traverse les pontons, vainc le monstre mécanique des mers et purifie l’océan.

story_chapters.title: MISSION 4 — BOSQUET D’AUTOMNE
story_chapters.text: Dans le Bosquet d’Automne, d’immenses scies abattent les arbres anciens. Maiya bondit de branche en branche et neutralise les bûcherons robotiques.

story_chapters.title: MISSION 5 — GROTTE DE CRISTAL
story_chapters.text: Sous terre, des forages fracturent les parois de cristal. Maiya s’enfonce dans les profondeurs et détruit le ver foreur titan.

story_chapters.title: MISSION 6 — ARBRE MONDE & LES ABÎMES
story_chapters.text: Maiya plonge dans les récifs submergés et escalade les racines du grand Arbre Monde pour briser les canalisations de déchets acides.

story_chapters.title: MISSION 7 — USINES DU RIO NEGRO
story_chapters.text: Dans la forteresse métallurgique du Rio Negro, Maiya infiltre les hauts-fourneaux et sabote les générateurs de smog.

story_chapters.title: MISSION 8 — LE VAUTOUR DE FER
story_chapters.text: À bord de l’Aigle Solaire, Maiya livre un duel aérien épique au milieu des orages pour abattre la forteresse volante du Vautour de Fer.

story_chapters.title: CHAPITRE FINAL — LA CITADELLE
story_chapters.text: Maiya infiltre la Citadelle, cœur du pouvoir de Smoggar. Elle brise les ultimes blindages et délivre enfin Sunboy de ses chaînes.

story_chapters.title: COMBAT FINAL — LORD SMOGGAR
story_chapters.text: Aux commandes d’un exosquelette titanesque, Smoggar tente d’écraser Maiya. Dans un déchaînement d’arts martiaux et d’énergie solaire, Maiya terrasse le tyran !

story_chapters.title: ÉPILOGUE
story_chapters.text: Les fumées se dissipent, la nature s’épanouit de nouveau. Sunboy rentre chez lui et Maiya retrouve Luna sous le feuillage fleuri de la vallée.

story_chapters.title: PRÓLOGO
story_chapters.text:
En el corazón de una tierra virgen se extienden valles de bosques, ríos y montañas.

Maiya y Luna, hermanas gemelas, conocen esta tierra mejor que nadie. Criadas en la naturaleza, son guerreras formidables expertas en artes marciales.

Pero extrañas máquinas industriales comienzan a invadir los valles bajo el mando del despiadado Lord Smoggar. Para acelerar sus planes, secuestra al joven príncipe Sunboy. ¡Maiya parte de inmediato a rescatarlo mientras Luna defiende el valle!

story_chapters.title: MISIÓN 1 — BOSQUE ESMERALDA
story_chapters.text: Maiya entra en el Bosque Esmeralda, dominado por las máquinas de Smoggar. Derrota a los soldados, rescata a los aldeanos y destruye la fábrica contaminante.

story_chapters.title: MISIÓN 2 — CASCADAS SAGRADAS
story_chapters.text: Escala las Cascadas Sagradas para desmantelar la maquinaria que desvía el agua pura y restablece el curso natural del río.

story_chapters.title: MISIÓN 3 — COSTA DE CORAL
story_chapters.text: En la Costa de Coral, refinerías vierten desechos en el mar. Maiya derrota al coloso marino mecanizado y devuelve la pureza al océano.

story_chapters.title: MISIÓN 4 — BOSQUE DE OTOÑO
story_chapters.text: En el Bosque de Otoño, sierras gigantes talan árboles milenarios. Maiya salta entre ramas y destruye los robots leñadores.

story_chapters.title: MISIÓN 5 — GRUTA DE CRISTAL
story_chapters.text: Bajo tierra, excavadoras fracturan las cavernas de cristal. Maiya desciende a las profundidades y vence al titánico gusano perforador.

story_chapters.title: MISIÓN 6 — ÁRBOL DEL MUNDO

story_chapters.title: PROLOG
story_chapters.text:
Im Herzen eines unberührten Landes liegen weite Täler voller Wälder, Flüsse und Berge.

Maiya und Luna, Zwillingsschwestern, kennen diese Welt wie niemand sonst. Aufgewachsen in der Natur, sind sie meisterhafte Kampfkünstlerinnen.

Doch düstere Industriemaschinen unter Lord Smoggar bedrohen die Heimat. Um seine Expansion zu erzwingen, entführt er Prinz Sunboy. Maiya bricht sofort auf, um ihn zu retten, während Luna ihr Tal beschützt!

story_chapters.title: MISSION 1 — SMARAGDWALD
story_chapters.text: Maiya betritt den Smaragdwald, besiegt die Vorhut von Smoggar, befreit die Dorfbewohner und zerstört die Giftfabrik.

story_chapters.title: MISSION 2 — HEILIGE WASSERFÄLLE
story_chapters.text: Sie erklimmt die Heiligen Wasserfälle, schaltet die Wasserumleitungsanlagen aus und stellt die reinigenden Quellen wieder her.

story_chapters.title: MISSION 3 — KORALLENKÜSTE
story_chapters.text: An der Korallenküste stoppt sie die Verschmutzung des Meeres und zwingt den mechanischen Titanen in die Knie.

story_chapters.title: MISSION 4 — HERBSTHAIN
story_chapters.text: Im Herbsthain schützt sie die uralten Bäume vor gewaltigen Kreissägen-Bots.

story_chapters.title: MISSION 5 — KRISTALLGROTTE
story_chapters.text: In den Tiefen der Kristallgrotte vernichtet sie den gigantischen Bohrwurm.

story_chapters.title: MISSION 6 — WELTENBAUM
story_chapters.text: Sie taucht zum versunkenen Riff und rettet die Wurzeln des Weltenbaums vor sauren Industrieabfällen.

story_chapters.title: MISSION 7 — RIO NEGRO WERKE
story_chapters.text: In den Hochöfen von Rio Negro sabotiert Maiya die Generatoren der Smog-Gilde.

story_chapters.title: MISSION 8 — DER EISENGEIER
story_chapters.text: Auf dem Rücken des Sonnenadlers besiegt sie die fliegende Festung des Eisengeiers im Sturm.

story_chapters.title: FINALES KAPITEL — DIE ZITADELLE
story_chapters.text: Sie dringt in die Zitadelle ein, überwindet die finalen Bollwerke und befreit Prinz Sunboy.

story_chapters.title: FINALE SCHLACHT — LORD SMOGGAR
story_chapters.text: Im epischen Duell gegen Smoggars riesiges Exoskelett erringt Maiya den triumphalen Sieg!

story_chapters.title: EPILOG
story_chapters.text: Der Himmel klart auf, die Wälder erblühen und Maiya kehrt glücklich zu Luna zurück.

story_chapters.title: PROLOGO
story_chapters.text:
Au cœur d’une terre vaste et préservée s’étendent des vallées de forêts, rivières et montagnes.

Maiya et Luna, sœurs jumelles, connaissent cette terre mieux que quiconque. Élevées au contact de la nature, elles maîtrisent les arts martiaux les plus redoutables.

Mais des machines polluantes surgissent sous le commandement du cruel Lord Smoggar. Pour accélérer son empire industriel, il fait enlever le jeune prince Sunboy. Maiya part aussitôt à sa rescousse tandis que Luna protège la vallée !

story_chapters.title: MISSIONE 1 — FORESTA DI SMERALDO
story_chapters.text: Maiya pénètre dans la Forêt d’Émeraude, où patrouillent les soldats et les machines de Smoggar. Elle repousse les assaillants, libère les villageois, anéantit le gardien et détruit l’usine toxique.

story_chapters.title: MISSIONE 2 — CASCATE SACRE
story_chapters.text: Maiya gravit les Cascades Sacrées pour stopper les machines qui détournent l’eau pure. Au sommet, elle terrasse la garnison ennemie et rend aux cascades leur cours naturel.

story_chapters.title: MISSIONE 3 — COSTA DI CORALLO
story_chapters.text: Sur la Côte de Corail, des complexes industriels déversent du poison dans la mer. Maiya traverse les pontons, vainc le monstre mécanique des mers et purifie l’océan.

story_chapters.title: MISSIONE 4 — BOSCO D’AUTUNNO
story_chapters.text: Dans le Bosquet d’Automne, d’immenses scies abattent les arbres anciens. Maiya bondit de branche en branche et neutralise les bûcherons robotiques.

story_chapters.title: MISSIONE 5 — GROTTA DI CRISTALLO
story_chapters.text: Sous terre, des forages fracturent les parois de cristal. Maiya s’enfonce dans les profondeurs et détruit le ver foreur titan.

story_chapters.title: MISSIONE 6 — ALBERO DEL MONDO
story_chapters.text: Maiya plonge dans les récifs submergés et escalade les racines du grand Arbre Monde pour briser les canalisations de déchets acides.

story_chapters.title: MISSIONE 7 — FABBRICHE DEL RIO NEGRO
story_chapters.text: Dans la forteresse métallurgique du Rio Negro, Maiya infiltre les hauts-fourneaux et sabote les générateurs de smog.

story_chapters.title: MISSIONE 8 — L’AVVOLTOIO DI FERRO
story_chapters.text: À bord de l’Aigle Solaire, Maiya livre un duel aérien épique au milieu des orages pour abattre la forteresse volante du Vautour de Fer.

story_chapters.title: CAPITOLO FINALE — LA CITTADELLA
story_chapters.text: Maiya infiltre la Citadelle, cœur du pouvoir de Smoggar. Elle brise les ultimes blindages et délivre enfin Sunboy de ses chaînes.

story_chapters.title: BATTAGLIA FINALE — LORD SMOGGAR
story_chapters.text: Aux commandes d’un exosquelette titanesque, Smoggar tente d’écraser Maiya. Dans un déchaînement d’arts martiaux et d’énergie solaire, Maiya terrasse le tyran !

story_chapters.title: EPILOGO
story_chapters.text: Les fumées se dissipent, la nature s’épanouit de nouveau. Sunboy rentre chez lui et Maiya retrouve Luna sous le feuillage fleuri de la vallée.

story_chapters.title: プロローグ
story_chapters.text:
緑豊かな大自然が広がる広大な渓谷。双子の姉妹「マイヤ」と「ルナ」は、武術の達人として谷の平和を守っていました。

しかし、冷酷な産業王「ロード・スモッガー」の公害軍団が谷を侵略し、太陽の王子サンボーイを誘拐します。マイヤは救出のため旅立ち、ルナは谷の守りを固めます！

story_chapters.title: ミッション1 — エメラルドの森
story_chapters.text: マイヤはエメラルドの森へ進撃し、スモッガーの伐採部隊を撃退して汚染工場を粉砕します。

story_chapters.title: ミッション2 — 聖なる滝
story_chapters.text: 滝をよじ登り、清らかな水源を汚す巨大タービンを破壊して清流を取り戻します。

story_chapters.title: ミッション3 — 珊瑚の海岸
story_chapters.text: 珊瑚の海にヘドロを流す海洋要塞を強襲し、水質汚染の元凶を討伐します。

story_chapters.title: ミッション4 — 黄金の秋の森
story_chapters.text: 紅葉の森で巨大回転鋸ロボット部隊を蹴散らし、自然の巨木を守り抜きます。

story_chapters.title: ミッション5 — 水晶の洞窟
story_chapters.text: 水晶の洞窟の地底深くへ潜入し、超大型採掘ドリルワームを撃破します。

story_chapters.title: ミッション6 — 世界樹の聖域
story_chapters.text: 世界樹の根に張り巡らされた硫酸パイプを断ち切り、世界の命脈を救います。

story_chapters.title: ミッション7 — リオ・ネグロ工場地帯
story_chapters.text: リオ・ネグロの製鉄要塞へ潜入し、毒煙ジェネレーターを停止させます。

story_chapters.title: ミッション8 — 鋼鉄のハゲワシ
story_chapters.text: 太陽の白鷹を駆り、雷雲の中で巨大飛行戦艦「鋼鉄のハゲワシ」との空中戦を制します。

story_chapters.title: 最終章 — 漆黒の要塞シタデル
story_chapters.text: 最終要塞シタデルに突入し、囚われのサンボーイ王子を救出します。

story_chapters.title: 決戦 — ロード・スモッガー
story_chapters.text: 巨大強化外骨格に搭乗したスモッガーと最終決戦。太陽拳の奥義で完全勝利を収めます！

story_chapters.title: エピローグ
story_chapters.text: 青空が戻り、緑が蘇ります。マイヤはルナの待つ故郷の森へと凱旋します。

zh_CN.hero_luna_desc: 致命利刃连斩、夜色秘术及超高速忍者冲刺。

story_chapters.title: 序章
story_chapters.text:
在广袤无垠的自然秘境中，双胞胎姐妹玛雅（Maiya）与露娜（Luna）是守护家园的格斗高手。

冷酷的工业巨头斯莫加（Lord Smoggar）率领机器军团侵入森林，并绑架了太阳王子桑男孩。玛雅毅然踏上救险征途，露娜留守保护谷地！

story_chapters.title: 第一关 — 翡翠森林
story_chapters.text: 玛雅突入翡翠森林，击退机械步兵，摧毁污染精炼厂。

story_chapters.title: 第二关 — 神圣瀑布
story_chapters.text: 攀登神圣瀑布，粉碎截流引水的水利涡轮，还大自然以清流。

story_chapters.title: 第三关 — 珊瑚海岸
story_chapters.text: 进军珊瑚海岸，击败巨型钢铁海怪，净化蔚蓝大海。

story_chapters.title: 第四关 — 黄金秋林
story_chapters.text: 在秋意盎然的古木林中，踩踏树冠斩除锯木机器人。

story_chapters.title: 第五关 — 水晶洞穴
story_chapters.text: 深入水晶地底溶洞，摧毁潜藏于黑暗中的钻探巨兽。

story_chapters.title: 第六关 — 世界树圣域
story_chapters.text: 潜入深海并登上世界树主干，拆除酸液管道，拯救大地生机。

story_chapters.title: 第七关 — 黑河工厂要塞
story_chapters.text: 潜入黑河炼钢工厂，破坏排污发电机。

story_chapters.title: 第八关 — 钢铁秃鹰
story_chapters.text: 骑乘太阳白鹰在雷云风暴中展开空战，轰落钢铁秃鹰空中堡垒。

story_chapters.title: 终章 — 斯莫加工业城堡
story_chapters.text: 攻陷终极城堡，解救被囚禁的桑男孩王子。

story_chapters.title: 决战 — 烟雾领主
story_chapters.text: 迎战身披重型蒸汽机甲的斯莫加领主，以自然奥义将其彻底击垮！

story_chapters.title: 尾声
story_chapters.text: 云雾散去，太阳普照，玛雅凯旋回归故里。

story_chapters.title: 프롤로그
story_chapters.text:
緑豊かな大自然が広がる広大な渓谷。双子の姉妹「マイヤ」と「ルナ」は、武術の達人として谷の平和を守っていました。

しかし、冷酷な産業王「ロード・スモッガー」の公害軍団が谷を侵略し、太陽の王子サンボーイを誘拐します。マイヤは救出のため旅立ち、ルナは谷の守りを固めます！

story_chapters.title: 미션 1 — 에메랄드 숲
story_chapters.text: マイヤはエメラルドの森へ進撃し、スモッガーの伐採部隊を撃退して汚染工場を粉砕します。

story_chapters.title: 미션 2 — 신성한 폭포
story_chapters.text: 滝をよじ登り、清らかな水源を汚す巨大タービンを破壊して清流を取り戻します。

story_chapters.title: 미션 3 — 산호 해안
story_chapters.text: 珊瑚の海にヘドロを流す海洋要塞を強襲し、水質汚染の元凶を討伐します。

story_chapters.title: 미션 4 — 황금 가을 숲
story_chapters.text: 紅葉の森で巨大回転鋸ロボット部隊を蹴散らし、自然の巨木を守り抜きます。

story_chapters.title: 미션 5 — 수정 동굴
story_chapters.text: 水晶の洞窟の地底深くへ潜入し、超大型採掘ドリルワームを撃破します。

story_chapters.title: 미션 6 — 세계수의 성역
story_chapters.text: 世界樹の根に張り巡らされた硫酸パイプを断ち切り、世界の命脈を救います。

story_chapters.title: 미션 7 — 리오 네그로 제철소
story_chapters.text: リオ・ネグロの製鉄要塞へ潜入し、毒煙ジェネレーターを停止させます。

story_chapters.title: 미션 8 — 강철 독수리
story_chapters.text: 太陽の白鷹を駆り、雷雲の中で巨大飛行戦艦「鋼鉄のハゲワシ」との空中戦を制します。

story_chapters.title: 최종장 — 시타델 요새
story_chapters.text: 最終要塞シタデルに突入し、囚われのサンボーイ王子を救出します。

story_chapters.title: 결전 — 로드 스모거
story_chapters.text: 巨大強化外骨格に搭乗したスモッガーと最終決戦。太陽拳の奥義で完全勝利を収めます！

story_chapters.title: 에필로그
story_chapters.text: 青空が戻り、緑が蘇ります。マイヤはルナの待つ故郷の森へと凱旋します。

story_chapters.title: PROLOG
story_chapters.text:
Im Herzen eines unberührten Landes liegen weite Täler voller Wälder, Flüsse und Berge.

Maiya und Luna, Zwillingsschwestern, kennen diese Welt wie niemand sonst. Aufgewachsen in der Natur, sind sie meisterhafte Kampfkünstlerinnen.

Doch düstere Industriemaschinen unter Lord Smoggar bedrohen die Heimat. Um seine Expansion zu erzwingen, entführt er Prinz Sunboy. Maiya bricht sofort auf, um ihn zu retten, während Luna ihr Tal beschützt!

story_chapters.title: UPPDRAG 1 — SMARAGDSKOGEN
story_chapters.text: Maiya betritt den Smaragdwald, besiegt die Vorhut von Smoggar, befreit die Dorfbewohner und zerstört die Giftfabrik.

story_chapters.title: UPPDRAG 2 — HELIGA VATTENFALLEN
story_chapters.text: Sie erklimmt die Heiligen Wasserfälle, schaltet die Wasserumleitungsanlagen aus und stellt die reinigenden Quellen wieder her.

story_chapters.title: UPPDRAG 3 — KORALLKUSTEN
story_chapters.text: An der Korallenküste stoppt sie die Verschmutzung des Meeres und zwingt den mechanischen Titanen in die Knie.

story_chapters.title: UPPDRAG 4 — HÖSTDUNGEN
story_chapters.text: Im Herbsthain schützt sie die uralten Bäume vor gewaltigen Kreissägen-Bots.

story_chapters.title: UPPDRAG 5 — KRISTALLGROTTAN
story_chapters.text: In den Tiefen der Kristallgrotte vernichtet sie den gigantischen Bohrwurm.

story_chapters.title: UPPDRAG 6 — VÄRLDSTRÄDET
story_chapters.text: Sie taucht zum versunkenen Riff und rettet die Wurzeln des Weltenbaums vor sauren Industrieabfällen.

story_chapters.title: UPPDRAG 7 — RIO NEGRO-VERKEN
story_chapters.text: In den Hochöfen von Rio Negro sabotiert Maiya die Generatoren der Smog-Gilde.

story_chapters.title: UPPDRAG 8 — JÄRNGRAMEN
story_chapters.text: Auf dem Rücken des Sonnenadlers besiegt sie die fliegende Festung des Eisengeiers im Sturm.

story_chapters.title: SISTA KAPITLET — CITADELLET
story_chapters.text: Sie dringt in die Zitadelle ein, überwindet die finalen Bollwerke und befreit Prinz Sunboy.

story_chapters.title: SLUTSTRIDEN — LORD SMOGGAR
story_chapters.text: Im epischen Duell gegen Smoggars riesiges Exoskelett erringt Maiya den triumphalen Sieg!

story_chapters.title: EPILOG
story_chapters.text: Der Himmel klart auf, die Wälder erblühen und Maiya kehrt glücklich zu Luna zurück.
